name: Shek Kingdom
description: The homeland of the Shek: a sparse, tribal kingdom in the Stenn Desert, ruled by Queen Esata the Stone Golem from Admag. The legendary warrior Kral united the warring tribes centuries ago, and the Shek have raided their neighbors ever since. Under the previous king, Shager, the Shek bled themselves in futile assaults on the Holy Nation. Esata wants to keep her people from fighting themselves extinct, which divides her warriors, and she tolerates outsiders for their trade, for now. Shek call humans flatskins.
